Self-evaluation maintenance theory | Self-evaluation maintenance (SEM) theory refers to discrepancies between two people in a relationship.  Two people in a relationship each aim to keep themselves feeling good psychologically throughout a comparison process to the other person.  Self-evaluation is defined as the way a person views him/herself.  It is the continuous process of determining personal growth and progress, which can be raised or lowered by the behavior of a close other (a person that is psychologically close).
